name: Native Window Management Suite
description: Provides Win32 and cross-platform native window enumeration, handle lookup, activation, closing, show/hide, positioning, resizing, title modification, and modal control.

ActiveWindow.description: Bring the specified window to the foreground and make it active

window.description: Window handle or title match expression

CloseWindow.description: Send a close signal (WM_CLOSE) to the specified window

window.description: Window handle or title match expression

EnumWindows.description: Enumerate all visible or top-level windows across the system and return window list

FindWindow.description: Find window handle by class name, title keyword, or process name
